heading: Purpose
lead: The purpose of this subpart is to provide teachers, principals, and other school professionals the tools they need to undertake reasonable actions to maintain order, discipline, and an appropriate educational environment.

notes.text: Codification Section was classified to section 6732 of this title prior to renumbering by Pub. L. 114–95.
